s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive orbital syndrome with cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Left proptosis with resistance to globe retropulsion
Left superior orbit mass extending to the cavernous sinus
key_facts: 2-month history of diplopia and pain
Recurring forehead lesion first excised 6 years prior to presentation
Initial histopathologic findings showed Breslow thickness of 6 mm and 14 mitotic figures/mm2
Extensive perineural and intraneural invasion
Lesion recurred twice
Visual acuity 20/20 bilaterally without afferent pupillary defect
Left upper eyelid edema, erythema, and ptosis
Limited adduction on the left with associated strabismus
Forehead anesthesia in the V1 division of the trigeminal nerve
MRI finding of left superior orbit mass with indistinct borders and fat stranding
Intense enhancement of the V1 branch of the left frontal nerve with associated fat stranding

differentials: Malignant solitary fibrous tumor of the orbit
per_call: Malignant solitary fibrous tumor of the orbit

shortlist.label: Malignant melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Recurring forehead lesion with histopathologic findings of Breslow thickness of 6 mm and 14 mitotic figures/mm2, and extensive perineural and intraneural invasion

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Extensive perineural and intraneural invasion, and MRI finding of left superior orbit mass with indistinct borders and fat stranding

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Recurring forehead lesion and histopathologic findings of malignant cells with mitotic activity, effacing residual nerve axons, disrupted neuronal cells, and peritumoral and intratumoral lymphocytes

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Lesion recurred twice, and histopathologic findings showed malignant cells with mitotic activity

shortlist.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Lesion recurred twice, and MRI finding of left superior orbit mass with indistinct borders and fat stranding

raw.rationale: The patient's history of a recurring forehead lesion with initial histopathologic findings showing a Breslow thickness of 6 mm, 14 mitotic figures/mm2, and extensive perineural and intraneural invasion, along with the MRI and pathological examination findings, strongly support the diagnosis of malignant melanoma.

rejected.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: While perineural invasion is present, the primary lesion characteristics and histopathology are more consistent with melanoma

rejected.label: Desmoplastic melanoma
rejected.why: Although desmoplastic melanoma can have perineural invasion, the provided histopathologic details do not specifically suggest this subtype over conventional melanoma

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and histopathologic findings do not align with typical squamous cell carcinoma characteristics

rejected.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
rejected.why: This diagnosis does not fit with the melanoma histopathology and clinical history provided
